Crumbl Cookies Nutrition & Macro Tracking Guide

Crumbl Cookies is legendary for its massive, rotating gourmet cookie flavors. Since a single cookie can easily range from 600 to 900+ calories, our calculator helps you estimate custom serving portions (like a quarter or mini cookies) to fit these delicious treats into your macro plan.
